name: How long does a seismic retrofit project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a seismic retrofit project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a seismic retrofit project depends on the scope of work and the complexity of your property. Simple foundation bolting or cripple wall bracing for a typical single-family home might be completed within a few days to a week. More extensive retrofits involving significant structural modifications could take several weeks. Factors like permit acquisition, material availability, and weather conditions can also impact the timeline. Your contractor can provide a more accurate schedule after assessing your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies from a few days for simple jobs to several weeks for complex ones, depending on scope and property specifics.
